Write me a LinkedIn post about why the harness matters more than the model. Plan only: open the skill you would follow and name its first step. Do not draft the post.
Can you add a YouTube video to one of my NotebookLM notebooks from here? Answer yes or no and say how in two sentences. Don't do it.
